name: Hernádkak (Hungary)
description: White field with a serrated border of blue and yellow triangles, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hernádkak: a crowned blue shield with a white star, a crescent and a church, above a scroll inscribed HERNÁDKAK.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
